summary: iPower Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of an initial $1 million purchase of USDai, a synthetic dollar token from the USD.AI protocol, as part of its AI infrastructure investment strategy. The company intends to stake the acquired tokens into sUSDai, a yield-bearing token. The filing is a routine current report on an ordinary investment activity, not a special situation. The purchase is neither an acquisition, divestiture, nor any other special-situation category; it is a standard business operation with no change in control, restructuring, or strategic review.
